claims.sourceText: National Archives, 'Record Group 615: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection', https://www.archives.gov/research/topics/uaps/rg-615
claims.text: NARA's Record Group 615 page, last reviewed 28 August 2026, lists the Federal Aviation Administration first among eight contributing agencies, at National Archives Identifier 493468575.

claims.nodeLabel: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection
claims.text: Eight agencies appear as RG 615 contributors as of 28 August 2026: FAA (catalog ID 493468575), NRC (488808322), ODNI (493468579), OSD (493468580), NSA (580103959), Department of State (608806625), FBI (580705010) and the Department of the Air Force (656595571). The Air Force was added on 28 August 2026; the preceding seven were in place by 22 May 2026.

claims.nodeLabel: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection
claims.text: The Department of the Air Force is the eighth contributor listed on NARA's Record Group 615 page and the first military department to appear as a contributor in its own right, as series 'Records from the Department of the Air Force Relating to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena', National Archives Identifier 656595571.

claims.nodeLabel: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection
claims.text: CIA, DIA, DOE, NASA, NRO, NGA, DHS, the Army and the Navy still have no series in RG 615 as of 28 August 2026, and NARA publishes no compliance list or non-compliance statement. The Department of the Air Force, which was in this list until 28 August 2026, now has one. Reasoning: direct inspection of the RG 615 contributor list and the FAQ, which addresses the framework and is silent on implementation status.
